critical_code_review_comments: /api/register-push correctly distinguishes upstream 401 (=> 500 with EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY detail) from 5xx (=> 502) from non-2xx (=> 400). Contract matches the playbook.

send_push() helper guards correctly: empty recipients short-circuits BEFORE the data validation, so callers with no recipients never get a ValueError even if their data dict is incomplete. Confirmed by unit test test_send_push_empty_recipients_returns_silently.

/api/send-push-internal swallows send_push() exceptions internally so Convex never sees a 5xx for a transient push failure — return value is always 202 once auth passes. This is intentional per the backend contract.
useEmergentPush has 3 trigger paths (auth ready, push token rotation listener, AppState foreground) and a 5-min throttle on identical user+token re-registrations — matches playbook §4.

Notifications.setNotificationChannelAsync('default', ...) is correctly at module scope (line 45 of _layout.tsx), NOT inside useEffect/component body. AndroidImportance.MAX is used. The other channels (messages-v2/calls/default-v3) live inside usePushNotifications and are intentionally preserved for the legacy Convex pipeline.
